objs.name: document
objs.description: Central managed object representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, or work instructions, subject to creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid the document belongs to.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation and consecutive number identifying the document (e.g. RL_0001).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released document version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document version remains valid.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable period (default 3 years) after which validity must be re-checked.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable period (default 10 years) after which archived documents are physically deleted.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope or area of validity of the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data referenced by the document.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications linked to the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or organizational units for which the document is relevant.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original Office format of the document content (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled sub-document attached to a main document, subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary non-controlled information object added to a document, not subject to a release cycle.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for changing an existing released document, managed independently of the document version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-generated request to review and extend the validity of a document before it expires.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request to invalidate a document and initiate the archiving process.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who participates in document management processes in various roles.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the user (e.g. Author, Co-Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator, Reader).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used to assign authorizations and distribution membership.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and individual persons assigned to receive a document upon release, either by email notification or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new documents.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported process instance that orchestrates approval steps such as creator sign-off, review, and release.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Digital signature recorded by workflow participants to confirm completion of a workflow step.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A tenant in a multi-client system in which documents can be made visible.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process that can be linked to documents for process-specific filing.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity to which documents can be linked.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document is created in the system by attaching a new information object with selection of a document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated via the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The approval process (Creator-Review-Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step of the release process.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content for technical and formal correctness.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document, making it available to readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, canceling the process for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created when revisions are made.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment is added to a main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: The content of an existing attachment is changed, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document without triggering a release cycle.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is removed from a document directly.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the associated document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the completion of a change proposal, removing it from the document display.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before the document validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser or full release team confirms the document remains valid, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document.

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: The document is declared out of force, revoking all rights except for the archive group.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: The Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate an invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is reactivated, creating a new version with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are notified by email when a new document version is released.

evts.name: distribute_document_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of the document via a workflow task.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or individual users for a document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated language version of a document is reviewed and released via workflow.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive period has expired, the archived document is physically deleted from the system.

o2o.description: An attachment belongs to and is controlled by a main document.
Additional information is supplementary to a document.
A change proposal belongs to a specific document.
A validity extension request is linked to the document whose validity must be checked.
An override request is created for a specific document to initiate invalidation.
A reactivation request is created for a specific archived document.
A document can reference another document (e.g. local extension referencing the original).
A document can be linked to a business process for process-specific filing.
A document can be linked to an organizational unit.
One or more templates can be defined per document type and selected when creating a document.
A distribution list is maintained per document to control distribution.
A user can be assigned to one or more user groups.
User groups are assigned to a document's distribution list.
Individual persons can be directly assigned to a document's distribution list.
A document can be made visible or hidden in specific clients in a multi-client system.
